opportunities.name: Rewind attack interlude
opportunities.objective: Test one Spellblade attack between a first bomb and the rewind-assisted second bomb.
opportunities.mechanic: Q waits three seconds unless a second bomb on the same unit detonates it and stuns. W removes ten seconds from other basic cooldowns; Lich Bane rewards an actual attack between the casts, and Nashor tests continued attacks during the double-bomb stun. E controls the approach while AP powers bombs and R revival healing.
opportunities.requiredState: First bomb attached, W ready and the attack cannot delay second Q past detonation.
opportunities.failure: The attack makes the second bomb miss or expire, losing the stun and burst.
opportunities.test: Compare Q-W-Q with Q-attack-W-Q at the same Q cooldown, tracking stun and item packets.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: W does not reset Spellblade item cooldown or the ultimate.

opportunities.name: Chronoshift recovery escort
opportunities.objective: Test movement and ally-heal delivery around an actual triggered revival.
opportunities.mechanic: E gives up to 99% movement speed or slow for 2.5 seconds. R marks an ally for five seconds and on lethal damage revives after three seconds stasis with 2 AP healing; Staff/Moonstone can be tested for eligibility on that heal. Shurelya helps the revived ally exit, while Mikael addresses eligible control.
opportunities.requiredState: R actually triggers on the intended ally, and allies remain nearby after the three-second stasis.
opportunities.failure: No lethal trigger yields no revive heal; a waiting enemy immediately kills the returning ally.
opportunities.test: Record revive heal and Staff/Moonstone activation, then escape distance with timed E/Shurelya.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Casting Chronoshift is not an immediate heal or shield and cannot immediately trigger every heal item.

ruledOut.idea: Basic haste resets Chronoshift via W
ruledOut.reason: W only reduces other basic ability cooldowns by ten seconds, excluding R.

unknowns: Passive tooltip is an unresolved localization token; passive summary only establishes experience transfer. Revive-heal item eligibility and double-bomb Spellblade timing need live tests.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: The attack makes the second bomb miss or expire, losing the stun and burst.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: W does not reset Spellblade item cooldown or the ultimate.
Confidence: plausible. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Lich Bane, Nashor's Tooth, Seraph's Embrace, Rabadon's Deathcap, Void Staff, Sorcerer's Shoes. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.

kitEvidence.formula:
Zilean tosses a time-delayed bomb that sticks to the first unit which comes within a small area around it. After [3] seconds it detonates, dealing [75 / 115 / 165 / 230 / 300 + (0.9) × AP] magic damage.

Placing a second bomb on a unit that already has one detonates the first bomb immediately and Stuns enemies in the blast for [1.1 / 1.2 / 1.3 / 1.4 / 1.5] seconds.

Zilean grants a protective time rune to an allied champion for [5] seconds. If the target would die, the rune rewinds their timeline, putting them into Stasis for [3] seconds, then reviving them and restoring [600 / 850 / 1100 + (2) × AP] Health.
Zilean turns time, reducing his other basic Ability Cooldowns by [10] seconds.
Zilean Slows an enemy champion by [40 / 55 / 70 / 85 / 99]% or grants an allied champion [40 / 55 / 70 / 85 / 99]% Move Speed for [2.5] seconds.
